diff_summary: Implemented the plan's file_change_proposal exactly, in the two allowed paths only. adws-pipeline/scripts/execution-report.js: added 'EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_BREACH' to NO_RETRY_REASONS (purely additive; decideLifecycle, exitCodeFor, DECISIONS, GATE_STATUSES and every gate key are untouched); added an exported TERMINAL_FAILURE_REASON_PRECEDENCE = ['EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_BREACH', 'ADVOCATE_DISSENT'] constant; added an exported failureReasonSeverity(reason) helper computed as a projection of NO_RETRY_REASONS union QUARANTINE_REASONS ('non-retriable' | 'retriable' | null); gave evalConsensus's blocking-dissent FAIL branch a failure_reason: 'ADVOCATE_DISSENT' field and evalSkillsClean's unreadable-evidence and trace/validator-mismatch FAIL branches a failure_reason: 'EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_BREACH' field (every other gate branch, including the Critic-fail and plain skill-failure branches, keeps failure_reason unset/null); buildReport now scans gates in precedence order to compute terminal_failure_reason (falling back to run_manifest's failure_reason) and failure_severity = failureReasonSeverity(terminal_failure_reason), and emits both as additive top-level report fields plus gates[].failure_reason; renderMarkdown prints both new fields next to Failure reason; SCHEMA_VERSION stays '1.4.0' with a comment recording why the additive-change version bump is deferred (parity/execution-report-fixtures/run-tests.js pins '1.4.0' exactly and parity/ is a blocked path for this job). adws-pipeline/references/phase-gates.md: replaced the two-bullet-list 'Failure-reason classes' section with a single canonical 'Terminal failure-reason table (SC-14)' carrying Reason | Severity | In-run retry | Verdict | When-recorded columns for every terminal reason (including the new EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_BREACH row and the parameterized {PHASE}_GATE_FAILURE row), followed by a reason-selection precedence rule, a sourcing rule, and a closed-enum restatement; updated the Contents bullet to name the new section; added a pointer to the table at the 'uphold' bullet and at the consensus terminal-enforcement rule. adws-pipeline/references/artifact-layout.md: documented failure_reason as a closed enum sourced from the phase-gates.md table (run_manifest.json field notes); added an execution_report.json entry under File shapes documenting terminal_failure_reason, failure_severity, and gates[].failure_reason as additive, rule-8-compliant keys; updated the Contents bullet. adws-pipeline/references/validator-inputs.md: extended the execution-report.js row in the Non-validator scripts table and the Verdict vocabularies table with the same sourcing rule, at the point an orchestrator actually looks the script up.
implementation_notes: Verification performed (see phase_log.md for full commands/output): (1) node --check on execution-report.js passes. (2) Measured the pre-change baseline myself by copying parity/execution-report-fixtures/quarantine_upheld_dissent/artifacts/job-4e5f6a, quarantine_trace_mismatch/artifacts/job-9b2e14, and quarantine_unreadable_manifest/artifacts/job-unr001 (with its declared chmod 0o000 on test/attempt_1/consensus/advocate.json) into scratch and running the pre-change CLI over the copies -- confirmed run_manifest/report failure_reason was null on all three and the only trace of the condition was a substring of a gate's free-text detail, exactly as plan/attempt_1/phase_log.md claimed. (3) Re-ran the same three scratch copies post-change: job-4e5f6a now reports gates.consensus.failure_reason='ADVOCATE_DISSENT', terminal_failure_reason='ADVOCATE_DISSENT', failure_severity='non-retriable', decision/exit unchanged at QUARANTINE/2; job-9b2e14 and job-unr001 both now report gates.skills_clean.failure_reason='EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_BREACH', terminal_failure_reason='EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_BREACH', failure_severity='non-retriable', decision/exit unchanged at QUARANTINE/2. (4) require()'d the module directly: failureReasonSeverity and TERMINAL_FAILURE_REASON_PRECEDENCE are exported; every member of NO_RETRY_REASONS and QUARANTINE_REASONS (union) maps to 'non-retriable'; BUILD_GATE_FAILURE and PROTECTED_BRANCH_BLOCKED map to 'retriable'; null/undefined/'' map to null; decideLifecycle({status:'failed', failureReason:'EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_BREACH', gates:[]}).decision === 'QUARANTINE'. (5) Deleted every gate.detail and decision_reason string from a parsed post-change report in memory and confirmed terminal_failure_reason/failure_severity were still fully determined -- a reader that never reads detail gets the same answer. (6) Ran the full parity/execution-report-fixtures/run-tests.js suite read-only (never against fixtures in place -- only scratch copies were ever mutated/chmod'd) both before and after the code change: 25/25 fixtures plus the CLI-error case pass identically, same decision/warn_flag/exit_code/schema_version for every case, deterministic across the suite's own double-run check. (7) git status --porcelain parity/ is empty after every run. Deviations from the plan: none -- all four files match the plan's file_change_proposal exactly; SCHEMA_VERSION deferral was carried out exactly as the plan specified, with the required comment placed beside the constant. Could not implement inside allowed_paths: nothing in the plan required a path outside adws-pipeline/references/ or adws-pipeline/scripts/execution-report.js. One known, plan-flagged, out-of-scope consequence confirmed empirically: adws-pipeline/skill-manifest.json is now stale (node scripts/local-ci/skill-manifest.mjs reports FAIL(5), naming exactly the four files this job changed) because the manifest file is outside policy.allowed_paths and this job may not touch it; frontmatter-lint.mjs (the reference bidirectional-index check) passes cleanly since no reference file was added or renamed. This is an operator decision per the plan, not a defect in this change.
